thread:
rachel: Quick draft of the internal release note for tomorrow's rollout. Can reviewers check phrasing and fallback lanes? Copy below.

rachel: [draft snippet]
- Rolling out model v2.3.1 (quantized) to Hosted + Dedicated at 10:00 PT
- Private customers: pin v2.3.0 by default; opt-in available
- Canary: 5% traffic for 30m, then 50% after 1h, full at 2h
- Rollback criteria: latency > 2.5x baseline OR error rate > 1% sustained for 10m
- Known issue: minor embedding variance with emoji-heavy inputs
Please add any legal/comms notes.

simon: LGTM. Suggest rewording 'embedding drift' -> 'embedding variance on emoji-rich inputs'.

alexa: Add a sentence for private customers: 'Customers on Private can request opt-in via support case; default remains v2.3.0'.

devops-bot: Deploy job #542 queued by @rachel for 2026-05-14T17:00:00Z — canary 5% — operators: @oncall-eng

oncall-eng: acked. I'll watch metrics and tracing flags. If anything noisy, I'll trigger rollback.

rachel: thanks. @simon can you add a one-line blurb for release notes on perf improvements? Maybe: 'up to 20% token throughput improvement on long context workloads'.

simon: added: 'Improves throughput for sequences >2k tokens; internal perf matrix shows median +18%.'

alexa: also add a 'what to expect' line for CS: 'no action required — opt-in only for Private deployments'.

rachel: updated draft. One small question — do we want to call out quantization level (int8 vs int4)?

simon: yes, call out int8 default; int4 is experimental and not recommended for latency-sensitive paths.

rachel: OK included.

devops-bot: Canary started — job #542 — canary traffic 5% -> metrics: latency +10%, errors 0.05% — monitoring tag: release/1767504321

oncall-eng: seeing slight CPU spike on the small TPU instances but within expectations. Traces show improved per-token time.

alexa: copy looks good to send to staff channels. Suggest adding a short rollback contact: 'If you need to rollback, ping #eng-oncall and tag @oncall-eng'.

rachel: adding rollback contact and schedule. Final draft below.

rachel: FINAL DRAFT:
Internal rollout timeline (10:00 PT): canary 5% for 30m -> 50% at 1h -> full at 2h.
Model: v2.3.1 (int8 quantized). Private customers remain pinned to v2.3.0 by default; opt-in via support case.
Improvements: median throughput +18% on >2k token contexts.
Rollback criteria: latency >2.5x baseline or errors >1% sustained for 10m. To rollback, ping #eng-oncall and tag @oncall-eng.
Known: slight emoji embedding variance — observed in internal tests, not expected to affect downstream features.

alexa: :thumbsup:

simon: :+1:

oncall-eng: on watch. Set a reminder for me at +1h to reassess.

devops-bot: Canary ramp to 50% complete. Metrics steady.

rachel: thank you everyone — I'll post this to #staff and schedule the announcement at 09:50 PT for the 10:00 PT window.

simon: small nit — change 'blast' to 'announcement' in final send.

rachel: done. Sending announcement now. Thanks!
